title: Plant Classification · Decision Tree
description: A simple flow to classify a plant in front of you by stem and height.

nodes.label: Is the stem thick, hard and woody?
Tree
nodes.detail: Tall plants with thick woody stems (e.g. mango, neem).

nodes.label: Is the stem hard but branching near the base?
Shrub
nodes.detail: Medium-sized plants with hard branching stems (e.g. rose, lemon).

nodes.label: Is the stem soft and green?
Herb
nodes.detail: Short plants with soft green stems (e.g. tulsi, mint).

nodes.label: Special form (climber / creeper)
nodes.detail: Some plants need support to grow up or spread along the ground.
